name: Gravedigger's kit
body:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 11
Price 265 gp; Weight 22 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit provides all the tools necessary to seal a coffin or other burial container and ensure that it stays closed. It includes 20 feet of chain, a good lock, 1 dose of alchemical cementUE, a folding shovelUE, a stubborn nailUE, and a leather-bound copy of the Pharasmin holy text, The Bones Land in a Spiral.
